This is a P1 precision/mapping fidelity compromise, not an established wrong idealized optimizer or observed historical failure. Named reference restores actual source BF16 pipeline, vector4 work assignment, fused transposes and explicit vendor GEMM ABI.

observation: Optimizer precision is an executable contract: an allFP32 implementation can reproduce the idealized recurrence while changing every BF16rounding boundary. Source-faithful working storage, fullstate captures and independent mixed-precision oracle distinguish that mapping choice. Diagonal and dense shapes expose orientation, vector tails and tile boundaries; they do not certify training convergence or exact polar orthogonality. Vendor matrix multiplications remain explicit interoperability, so whole-step timing is not a pure authored-kernel framework comparison.
effort_observation: NativeCUDA12.0 build failed unavailable packedBF16 APIs; scalar-equivalent adapter diagnostic succeeded, then original source succeeded using available12.9.41 compiler with systemruntime/library12.0. The diagnostic adapter is not primary and no native scientific defect is claimed. Shared host Julia generator parse repair occurred before any device JIT. NumPy import probe unavailable; independent oracle uses standard-library scalar math instead, not a framework limitation. A second shared host ABI lookup failure (CUDA.CUstream not exported) was repaired before device JIT by passing the installed opaque CuStream.handle pointer; actual authored GPU candidates first compiled in final reference process. Shared dependency setup is retained separately from model kernel compiler failures.
